run_findings.obot_request_bound_acr: Current resources.go authorizes GET/POST/DELETE /mcp-connect/{mcp_id}; evaluateResources extracts mcp_id and calls checkMCPID. For normal authenticated users checkMCPID calls CheckMCPIDAccess using a.uncached and current ACR/server/catalog/workspace state before the proxy path. An effect-bearing POST is therefore independently current-authorized rather than inheriting initialize-time authority.
run_findings.obot_long_lived_session: For POST tool calls through /mcp-connect, successful initialize is not a reusable authorization lease: later POST requests re-enter current authorization. Classify REQUEST_BOUND_CURRENT_AUTH, not TRUE_EXTERNAL_REVISION_GATE, because no independent auth revision is atomically consumed by the upstream effect system.
run_findings.obot_scope_exceptions: Hosted agents intentionally use their own administrator/owner-checked authorized_mcp_ids grant rather than the owner's current reachability; system MCP servers shift authorization downstream. Capability detection must bind the authority to the actual principal, not assume owner ACL revocation revokes an independent agent grant.
run_findings.agent_provenance_still_absent: Obot's current access decision is boolean/error enforcement on the gateway request path; it is not surfaced to the MCP client as a durable revocation epoch capsule. Strong effect binding can exist without agent-visible provenance.
